newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on India 364-day t-bill falls to 8.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on India 364-day t-bill falls to 8.85 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 91.89 rupees at an auction of 364-day treasury bills on Wednesday.
Dealers said the yield fell to 8.85 percent from 9.0 percent at the last auction.
The RBI said it received 28 bids for 12.26 billion rupees of which it accepted 18 for 9.61 billion rupees at a cut-off rate of 91.89 rupees.
The devolvement on primary dealers amounted to 1.0 billion rupees and the total face value of bills issued was 10.61 billion rupees, RBI said.
The weighted average cut-off was 91.94 rupees.
